1936, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 140 Cont.
Sep. 10 Margaret Quinlivan - about 55 - asthma - nearly smothers at times. Alfred Jas. Quell - 20 - no Easter - heart trouble
13 Marg. Brennan - 70 - bronchitis - very ill. Ann M. Cyr ... looking for work.
Matilda King - 80 - now down for 9 mo. - Kidney trouble and artery hard'n
Page 141
Sep. 15 Ettie Stewart - 80 -of Whitby Ontario - blind and paralyzed - en- rolled last Thursday (Sept. 10th). She can talk now and her sight is quite returned. Also her ability to walk.
Myron Bloomfield - 40 - of Mackinac Isl. - blood stream defective: has wife and family depending on.
Mrs. Cora Packer - 63 - tripped(pots) - fractured ankle - had not walked for two years, till brought to Monastery (in February 1934) Drs. (St. Joseph Hosp. Pontiac) said she'd never walk. - walks perfectly .
Farrington Holt - 38 - Convert but fell away through drink and for seven years was not to confession. This man was enrolled in the Ser. M. A. (in Febr. 1934) and for a week drank worse than ever; so that ... sent to Dearborn and was believed to - hopeless. Shortly after came back to monastery .... went to confession - now .... no more drink.
Bazar - 3 day - Festival: Oct. 25 - '7 pray ... (tickets)
Howard Haskins - 9 - blind since birth - father was bitter non Cath. - was enrolled two yrs. ago - was rather hopeless. ..... now eye seems quite on way to perfect sight. Father claimes its only by prayer - now taking instruction.
Mrs. T. Gaffke - 41 - lost one breast a month ago - now fears fur- ther development.
Page 142 Sep. 15 16 Ronald Tho's Emerick - one year old To-day has never sat up or tried to sit up. Was enrolled about three months ago in Ser. Mass Ass'n and has steadily improved since. Already smiled and notices. Was enrolled To-night $5.00
